items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I knew Cutty. I played with him you know, more than a few times at the Eddie Condon’s in midtown in the 50s.

ctx.x: I knew Cutty. I played with him you know, more than a few times at the Eddie Condon’s in midtown in the 50s. And somehow we got onto this. And it turns out he was from eastern Pennsylvania or something like that, you know I was born in Martin’s Ferry, which is on the Ohio River down the river from Pittsburgh a hundred miles or not even that. And he was from that area, and he too, even though he didn’t have the Hungarian background, he too loved the gypsy bands and the bass player going zoom — zoom — zoom. So it…
You would have been pretty young during the Depression.
